title: Wed Nov 4: Siri AI opens to developers, Anthropic's $895B commitments, OpenAI hires Anthropic's hackers
description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: Apple's Siri AI developer preview in iOS 27.3 betas; Anthropic's amended S-1 details (Q3 revenue, operating loss, $895B commitments, RSP warning) and Cat Wu's exit; OpenAI partners with Cathedral and reprices its bug bounty; CrowdStrike AI Kill Switch and acquisitions; Google ties Search to AI for K-12 accounts; ChatGPT usage numbers and LifeVal; caveats on MIT weight-editing result; DeepSeek on Huawei Ascend; quick hits.
